name: Prismatic Spray
description:
Five multicolored rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Roll Spirit vs Dexterity against up to five creatures within medium range. On each win, roll a d6 to determine which color ray affects it:

  • 1: White - the creature's attack rolls are ill-favored for 1 minute.

  • 2: Blue - the creature's current MP is halved.

  • 3: Black - the creature takes -5 Defense for 1 minute.

  • 4: Red - the creature takes 5d6 damage.

  • 5: Green - the creature takes 2d10 damage and falls prone.

  • 6: Roll twice more and apply each effect.

If you choose to target fewer than five creatures, you may direct the extra rays at existing targets. If you win the roll against that target, roll an additional time for each additional ray.

Describe the colors.
successes:
✨: You create one additional ray.

🌞: On each win, you may choose which color affects the creature (you may not choose the 6 effect).
